newsitem.title: USA: IBM stock price seen rising - NYT.
newsitem.headline: IBM stock price seen rising - NYT.

text.p: The price of International Business Machines Corp (IBM) stock could rise in the next year as the American computer giant educates analysts and investors about its strengths, the New York Times reported on Monday.
In its Market Place column, the newspaper quoted analysts as saying that the stock's current low valuation also gave them reason to think that it could go higher.
On Friday, the stock closed at $124-3/4.

Daniel Mandresh of Merrill Lynch & Co said IBM stock could trade at $150 within the next year "because it only requires the market to give IBM a valuation of 11 times his 1997 earnings estimate of $13.75 a share." It currently was trading at 8.9 times estimated 1997 earnings.
Denis Laplaige at mutual fund Mackay Shields said he was optimistic about the company's future after attending a meeting with IBM executives.
"This company has the technology, systems and management that can take it back to a leadership position in the new century," he was quoted as saying.
